title: Start external review during pending CI

rubric.text: Begins review while CI is pending: retains draft for proven support when CI runs there, requests supported draft review then promptly marks ready when CI is ready-only, and permits earlier readiness for unsupported or unverified draft review. Waits for neither review nor CI completion before readiness unless explicitly required.
Uses supplied repository-scoped evidence; records unknown draft support and requires review-start/current-head readback, without inferring success or changing settings.
Separates PR readiness from delivery ready and merge authority; pending CI and external review continue to block acceptance and merge.
